data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, the name Trisha derives from the word ‘Tryambaka,’ which refers to the three-eyed goddess Tripura Sundari. This name symbolizes love, beauty, and prosperity, as well as the divine feminine power. It is believed that the name Trisha brings happiness, success, and good fortune to those who bear it. The name Trisha carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Trisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
